# openobserve_stream (Data Source)

Reads an existing OpenObserve stream's schema, settings, and statistics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_stream" "app_logs" {
  name        = "app_logs"
  stream_type = "logs"
}

output "app_log_fields" {
  value = [for f in data.openobserve_stream.app_logs.schema : f.name]
}

output "app_log_retention_days" {
  value = data.openobserve_stream.app_logs.data_retention
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stream name.
- `stream_type` (String) Stream type: `logs`, `metrics`, `traces`, or `metadata`.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `bloom_filter_fields` (Set of String) Fields with bloom filter acceleration.
- `compressed_size` (Number) Compressed storage size in bytes.
- `data_retention` (Number) Retention period in days.
- `defined_schema_fields` (Set of String) Fields kept in the user-defined schema.
- `doc_count` (Number) Number of documents ingested.
- `enable_distinct_fields` (Boolean) Whether distinct value tracking is on.
- `enable_log_patterns_extraction` (Boolean) Whether log pattern extraction is on.
- `full_text_search_keys` (Set of String) Fields included in full-text search.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{stream_type}/{name}`.
- `index_all_values` (Boolean) Whether every field value is indexed.
- `index_fields` (Set of String) Fields with a secondary index.
- `index_original_data` (Boolean) Whether the original document is indexed.
- `max_query_range` (Number) Maximum query time range in hours.
- `partition_keys` (Attributes List) Partition keys configured on the stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partition_keys))
- `schema` (Attributes List) Columns discovered in the stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))
- `storage_size` (Number) Uncompressed storage size in bytes.
- `storage_type` (String) Storage tier of the stream.
- `store_original_data` (Boolean) Whether the original document is retained.
- `total_fields` (Number) Number of fields in the stream schema.

<a id="nestedatt--partition_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `partition_keys`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the key has been retired.
- `field` (String) Partition key field.
- `hash_buckets` (Number) Bucket count for hash partitioning.
- `type` (String) Partitioning strategy.


<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Field data type.
